investigation_notes.Host Past Queries: Host previously queried eu.dotnxdomain.net and similarly structured names within recent events, indicating ongoing communication with the root domain.
investigation_notes.Description: Multiple DNS A queries to dotnxdomain.net contain high-entropy, structured subdomains with repeating identifiers and keyword-like fragments while the response size (574 bytes vs typical 28) is anomalously large. The root domain is long-established (created 2012-09-04) and the host has prior history of querying the same root, indicating ongoing activity rather than a single misconfiguration. Despite the domain's age, the large payloads, high-entropy subdomain encoding, and repeated structured queries are consistent with DNS tunneling and potential data exfiltration, so this alert requires escalation as High Priority.
